bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest recent Bears story centers on left tackle Ozzy Trapilo's remarkable recovery, as GM Ryan Poles gave an encouraging update ahead of the Week 1 opener against Carolina, noting there's still no clarity on a return timeline, but the mere fact that he's already participating in team drills and wearing pads is encouraging, and while he won't make any promises about a return date, Trapilo is clearly far ahead of schedule . Poles also acknowledged the second-year tackle still needs to shake off rust, saying "There's definitely rust to knock off...

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions have made several roster adjustments ahead of the 2026 season opener, placing running back Isiah Pacheco on injured reserve—where he will be eligible to be activated off IR ahead of Detroit's Week 5 matchup against Arizona —while also making a decision on veteran tight end Tyler Conklin and waiving center Seth McLaughlin, leaving the Lions no choice but to put all their faith in Juice Scruggs at center . Elsewhere, running back Jahmyr Gibbs was among a group of six Detroit Lions voted into the 2026 NFL Top 100 , adding a bright spot to a roster still working through injury-related depth questions.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: Running back Josh Jacobs has been placed on the NFL's Commissioner's Exempt List amid pending charges, and NFL Network's Stacey Dales analyzed the Packers' running game plan during his absence . General manager Brian Gutekunst said he is hopeful the three-time Pro Bowl running back plays this season, though Green Bay will "be prepared either way" as the team preps for its Week 1 matchup against the Vikings.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings have added veteran depth on defense, signing 13-year outside linebacker Kyle Van Noy to their practice squad after he agreed to terms with the team, reuniting him with defensive coordinator Brian Flores, with whom he won two Super Bowls in New England. The move addresses a need at edge rusher following Jonathan Greenard's trade to Philadelphia and Tyler Batty's season-ending ACL injury, with Van Noy joining a group on the edge that includes Andrew Van Ginkel and Dallas Turner, though the rest of the rotation remains unsettled as Minnesota prepares to open its season against Green Bay.
